questions.question_text: You notice that the 'Percentage CPU' metric for an Azure virtual machine has been above 80% for the past 10 minutes. Which action should you take to proactively address potential performance issues?

options.label: A
options.text: Ignore it, it's normal.

options.label: B
options.text: Create an alert rule based on this metric.

options.label: C
options.text: Delete the metric.

options.label: D
options.text: Change the metric source.

questions.explanation: According to Azure Monitor documentation, you can create an alert rule using the metric in the Azure portal or via ARM templates to trigger actions when thresholds are crossed.

questions.question_text: Your team needs to retain diagnostic logs from a storage account for 365 days and send them to a Log Analytics workspace. Where do you configure the retention period?

options.label: A
options.text: In the storage account's access tier settings.

options.label: B
options.text: In the Azure portal under Monitoring > Diagnostic settings.

options.label: C
options.text: In the Azure Policy definition for the storage account.

options.label: D
options.text: In the resource group's network security group.

questions.explanation: Retention and routing of diagnostic logs are configured in the Diagnostic settings blade of the storage account, as described in the Azure Monitor documentation.

questions.question_text: You need to write a Kusto query to identify all failed VM boot events in the last 7 days from the AzureActivity table. Which query is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: AzureActivity | where Status == "Failed" | where OperationName == "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start" | project TimeGenerated, OperationName, Status, ResourceGroup | order by TimeGenerated desc;

options.label: B
options.text: AzureActivity | where OperationName == "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start" | where Status == "Failed" | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | project TimeGenerated, ResourceGroup, Status;

options.label: C
options.text: AzureActivity | where Status == "Failed" | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | summarize count() by ResourceGroup;

options.label: D
options.text: AzureActivity | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d) | where OperationName == "Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachines/start" | summarize count() by Status.

questions.explanation: The query must filter on both the operation name for VM start and the failed status, and restrict the time range to the past 7 days, which is exactly what option B does.

questions.question_text: You are configuring an alert rule for a production web app. The alert should trigger when the request count exceeds 10,000 per minute, and you need to send an email to the operations team and create a work item in Azure DevOps. Which combination of actions should you include?

options.label: A
options.text: Email notification via action group and Azure DevOps webhook.

options.label: B
options.text: Email notification via action group and Azure Function.

options.label: C
options.text: SMS notification via action group and Logic App.

options.label: D
options.text: Email notification via action group and Azure DevOps service hook.

questions.explanation: An action group can include an email notification and a webhook action that points to an Azure DevOps service hook, enabling creation of work items as described in the Azure Monitor alert documentation.

questions.question_text: You want to test network connectivity from an on-premises data center to an Azure virtual network subnet using Azure Network Watcher. Which feature should you use?

options.label: A
options.text: Connection Monitor

options.label: B
options.text: NSG Flow Logs

options.label: C
options.text: Traffic Manager

options.label: D
options.text: Azure Front Door

questions.explanation: Azure Network Watcher's Connection Monitor evaluates end-to-end connectivity between on-premises resources and Azure subnets, as detailed in the Network Watcher documentation.
